Then you'd better prepare for an Empire attack, Exec Temora&mdash;!''"<br />"''If Darth Vader ''is'' on his way here, our best chance is to meet him in ''space!''|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a [[Unidentified Rebel pilot 1 (Arda II)|Rebel pilot]], to [[Temora]]|<ref name="ALAWL" />}}
The '''attack on Arda II''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that took place in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda II]].<ref name="ALAWL" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You can give our X-wing fighters ''protection'' that would ''triple'' our chances in battle!|Luke Skywalker, to Temora|<ref name="ALAWL" />}}
The [[StarWars.com]] article, "Time Capsule: Darth Vader 1980" identified the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] group that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] leads in this battle as "Blue Flight," [[Retroactive continuity|retconning]] [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] into this battle.<ref name="TCDV1980" />
